name: jump
lore:
### On the Transmutation of Verticality: The *Jump* Spell

To the uninitiated, the *Jump* spell manifests as a fleeting distortion—a shimmering, translucent coil of kinetic force that wraps the caster's calves like ethereal springs. When shaping the Weave for this enchantment, one does not feel the usual fluid grace of magic; instead, the mana becomes a violent tension, akin to a longbow drawn to its breaking point. It is the magic of potential energy, held in a vibrating stasis until the moment of release.

Legends attribute the spell’s discovery to the hermit-sage **Valerius the Nimble**. Trapped within the Crags of Despair by a prowling manticore, Valerius spent days observing the effortless bounds of the mountain-ibex. By mimicking what he termed the "tightening of the earth’s own breath," he fashioned a formula to defy the crushing weight of the world. 

Today, it remains an essential tool for the wayfarer. When the spell takes hold, the ground ceases to be an anchor and becomes a mere suggestion—a springboard into the waiting sky. Use it wisely, for while the climb is magical, the descent remains entirely governed by the laws of stone.
